The '''subteroth''' was a bipedal [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Makeb]].<ref name="Rise">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>

Subteroths typically lived in deep underground caverns, and hunted using scent and the crest on the back of their head, a hypersensitive organ that picks up the electromagnetic fields of a prey's heartbeat and transmits it directly to their nervous system. When their native planet was invaded by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] in [[3638 BBY]], the subsequent mining of [[Isotope-5]] caused ground-quakes that drove the subteroths
out of their normal hunting grounds and toward the surface.<ref name="Subteroth" />

[[File:Subteroth.0001.png|thumb|left|250px|A gigantic female Subteroth on Oricon]]
In the last stages of the [[Dread War]], several Makeb predators were taken to the [[Oricon]] moon where they were used in the defense of the [[Dread Masters]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> Among them were the Subteroths who were corrupted and tasked with guarding the [[Dread Fortress]].

Two gigantic Subteroths could be found in the [[Dread Cavern]] area north of the Dread Fortress.<ref name="SD">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Imperial|Seeds of Dread|Oricon}}</ref>

In the Dread Fortress itself, packs of smaller Subteroths patrolled its corridors and attacked any intruders; however, these creatures were altered in such a way so as to explode when slain.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a Heliotropic Subteroth minipet was given to all players with accounts active on May 11, 2014. Another pet, the Deepcrest Subteroth, can be obtained by killing [[Draxus]] in the [[Dread Fortress]].
